# External Diagnostic Datasets

These datasets may supplement component diagnostics for layout, tables, multilingual forms, and synthetic OCR variation. They do not replace the project-owned synthetic end-to-end Golden Dataset.

No external dataset is downloaded automatically or committed to this repository. Before adoption, pin an exact source revision, complete license and privacy review, define a deterministic subset manifest and checksum, and keep its metrics separate from Agent-report headline metrics.

Run `pnpm dataset:external` to inspect the registry.
